items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: Lawrence Walt must have umpteen numbers.

ctx.x: They had the Lions and the Eleanor too.

Yeah, they got the Lions and the Eleanor Social Club. Well, they all play, they all have a colored band when you see them. And believe me, they do strut. I mean, strut. It reminds me, years ago when the colored would take their dead, I don't know if they still do it, they'd play when the Saints go marching by and they'd be playing so nice, you know, when they come back. I'll be glad when you rascal you or I'll be glad when you're gone or didn't you ramble when you're coming back to just be jazzing it. Because…
